about: The Juice Merchant is an independent juice bar serving Narberth with cold-pressed juices, smoothies, and bowls made fresh to order. The focus stays on simple, clean ingredients rather than anything overcomplicated, whether it is a quick juice on the way out the door, a smoothie bowl to sit down with, or a full multi-day cleanse package for a reset. Catering trays are also available for local events and gatherings around Narberth, built from the same juice, smoothie, and bowl menu regulars already order. Every order is made when it is ordered, not poured from a bottle that has been waiting on a shelf, which keeps the ingredients and the routine simple for anyone stopping in on the way to work, after a workout, or on the way home.
